_comment: HYDRA v1.0 CORE head — the thesis bet. Single-coin (config.coin, or HYDRA_COIN env) trend-momentum: LONG when 4h structure is bullish, SHORT when bearish, sit out a neutral tape. Conviction-tiered leverage (apexScore -> maxLeverage, else stdLeverage). One position per wallet. This is one of three heads (core/dip/hedge) of a single-coin portfolio fund; pairs with the dip + hedge heads on SEPARATE wallets, all with the same HYDRA_COIN. Set wallet/strategyId/chatId (and HYDRA_COIN or coin). Runtime owns position tracking, caps, DSL via runtime-core.yaml. Producer launched with HYDRA_LEG=core.
_coin_note: This is the Hydra-SOL variant (HYDRA_COIN=SOL). hedge stressDropPct 10 — wider than ETH (SOL is more volatile). One of three head wallets (core/dip/hedge); all three share this HYDRA_COIN. Same engine across all coins.
_role_note: CORE = the directional thesis spine. It is the only head that goes both ways (long the uptrend / short the downtrend) and the only one always-on. The dip head presses pullbacks (uptrends only); the hedge head shorts stress (downtrends only). Fund default sizing: core 50% / dip 25% / hedge 25% of the coin's combined budget (operator funding split across the three wallets).
_persona: Single-coin thesis bet — conviction-tiered trend-momentum on one major, both directions, let-winners-run DSL, time-cuts off (single-asset standard). The spine of a Hydra single-coin portfolio fund.
_v21_note: v2.1: requireDailyAlign — only enter when the 1d trend confirms the 4h. Filters chop (don't buy the range-top); in a range the 1d is NEUTRAL so the core stands down. Pair with the loose catastrophic DSL: enter only on a confirmed 1d+4h trend, then ride it.
